To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the vascular disrupting agent combretastatin-A4 phosphate (CA-4P) significantly improves the response of tumors to radiation, but has no significant effect on normal tissue response.
the radiation response of foot tumors was significantly enhanced by CA4P but the response of early responding skin, bladder and late responding lung were not affected by CA4P.
VDAs enhance tumor response to radiation, but do not affect the response of early or normal responding late normal tissues.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel radiation sensitizers for the treatment of cancer.
the study of the effects of the combined use of radiation with the vascular disrupting agent combretastatin-A4-phosphate (CA4P) on the response of tumors and normal tissues.
the use of vascular disrupting agents (VDA) in cancer therapy, in particular in the treatment of brain tumours.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of CA4P with radiotherapy significantly improves the tumor response without increasing normal tissue toxicity.
the VDA tested in this study, CA4P, has no effect on the response of early or delayed responding normal tissues to radiation.
CA4P enhances the radiation response of C3H mouse mammary carcinoma tumors but not early and late responding normal tissues, and that this is likely to be the case for other VDAs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
VDAs enhance tumor radiation response without increasing normal tissue radiation toxicity.
VDAs can significantly improve the therapeutic ratio of radiation therapy.
VDAs can be used safely in the clinic in combination with radiotherapy to treat tumors, without any increase in normal tissue damage.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VDAs are likely to have a significant impact on the therapeutic ratio of radiation therapy.
combining radiation with VDAs may significantly increase the therapeutic ratio of radiation.
combining VDAs with radiation should be safe, and that this combination should be explored clinically.
